label: Bible Study
prompt: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the _____.
verse: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
note: Job remembers better days — he was eyes for the blind and feet for the lame.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good _____, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verse: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
note: After a day of uproar in Jerusalem, the Lord stood by Paul that night: cheer up — Rome is next.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the _____ of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verse: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
note: While the sailors prayed and tossed cargo overboard, Jonah was fast asleep down in the sides of the ship.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a _____ land.
verse: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
note: Isaiah's portrait of a righteous king: shade from a great rock in a dry, exhausted land.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but _____ to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verse: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
note: 'Condescend to men of low estate' — in KJV English a good thing: stoop gladly to fellowship with the lowly.
